article.linkText: Heat open season at home against the Timberwolves
article.story: Minnesota Timberwolves vs. Miami Heat Miami; Wednesday, 7:30 p.m. EDT LINE: Heat -1.5; over/under is 243.5 BOTTOM LINE: The Miami Heat start the season at home against the Minnesota Timberwolves. Miami finished 43-39 overall with a 26-15 record at home during the 2025-26 season. The Heat averaged 8.6 steals, 4.3 blocks and 13.1 turnovers per game last season. Minnesota finished 49-33 overall last season while going 23-18 on the road. The Timberwolves averaged 118.0 points per game last season, 19.0 on free throws and 41.4 from 3-point range. INJURIES: Heat: Dru Smith: out (calf). Timberwolves: Donte DiVincenzo: out (achilles). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
